what_the_maintainer_authorised: A criterion built for partial recurrence, conditional on it being what the work needs: 'something built for partial recurrence (scoring how much of a window a configuration spans rather than thresholding it), or accumulating evidence across partitions rather than within one, which is what the mining machinery actually needs.' The conditional was then resolved against the evidence rather than assumed, and the maintainer authorised the resulting plan -- declare the partial-presence construction and its ground truth, build it, verify the labels are sound, and only then declare a criterion against it.
how_the_conditional_was_resolved_before_: Both authorised options were untestable on the evidence that existed, and both reasons were derivable rather than measured. Recurrence across partitions is not a distinct phenomenon in this generator: the blocks are disjoint seed ranges over independent draws with the same motif shape at a random centre and rotation, so scenes within a block differ from one another exactly as scenes across blocks do. And partial recurrence is absent from the evidence entirely, because plant is a per-scene flag and every planted scene carries the motif. A criterion built for partial recurrence and measured where recurrence is total cannot fail for the right reason or pass for the right reason. So the first authorised thing the work needed was a test bed, and that is what this adopts.
what_was_adopted: Construction of the partial-presence development partitions 800-835 and the partial-presence null 850-855, at presence levels j in {3, 4, 5} and the three declared richness levels, and the audit of their ground truth against the design's five conditions. Nothing else.
what_this_is_not: It is not the adoption of any criterion. No rule is declared, measured or adjudicated by it, and a criterion for these partitions needs its own declaration with its own acceptance and its own blindness claim -- written before the audit's numbers are used to shape it.
the_reserved_partial_presence_blocks_are: 880-895 were reserved in the design declaration before a single partial-presence scene existed, and are refused unconditionally in code by ReservedPartialPresenceScene -- with no confirmatory flag, because no amendment opening them exists and a flag that could would be a door left ajar. Blocks 720-735 remain separately reserved and are total-recurrence partitions, which is why a new reservation was needed at all: the property under test is absent from them.
what_is_derivable_and_must_not_be_report: Candidate 2 requires a group spanning every scene, so at j < S no such group containing the motif exists and its false split is 1.0000 on this evidence before it is run. Candidate 3 recovers the motif only at j = 5. Both are arithmetic, both were stated in the design declaration, and neither is a discovery about a passing or a falsified candidate. This evidence exists to make a question answerable, not to re-adjudicate settled ones.
what_this_evidence_still_does_not_supply: Epoch-to-epoch recurrence, which the second of the maintainer's two options named and which this generator cannot produce. Partial presence is repaired; recurrence across genuinely separated epochs is not, and the acquired-record path still owes it. Nothing built on these partitions may be reported as evidence about it.
scope_adopted: Atmospheric identity path only. R19 applies: the mechanism is domain-agnostic, this evidence is atmospheric and synthetic, and cross-domain use needs its own declared experiment.
governing: Already inspected data do not become untouched by renaming them. Once these partitions are built and inspected they are development evidence permanently.
A named refusal is preferable to an unsupported number. Ambiguous motif labelling is refused by name and counted, not guessed.

Nothing here approves a mining radius, discharges T4E.8's acquired-record acceptance, or closes D96, D97, D98, D99 or D100. The primary scientific target remains kind_recurrence, which still has no catalogue.

audit_outcome.status: ALL FIVE CONDITIONS MET. The test bed is what the design says it is.
audit_outcome.condition_1_presence_counts: MET. Exactly j scenes hold a motif configuration and exactly 6 - j hold none, at every j and every richness.
audit_outcome.condition_2_no_leakage_by_configuration_: MET. Every scene of every partition holds the same number of configurations -- 20 at richness 6, 84 at 9, 220 at 12 -- whether or not it holds the motif. Presence cannot be read off the size of a scene.
audit_outcome.condition_3_labels_refused_rather_than_g: MET, with zero refusals. No scene in the 39 built had an ambiguous motif labelling, so the ground truth under every future error rate is construction throughout and nothing was guessed.
audit_outcome.condition_4_absent_scenes_are_ordinary: MET. Absent scenes carry distractors drawn by the same minimum-separation rule as present ones and hold no motif configuration. Absence is the absence of the motif, not a different kind of scene.
audit_outcome.condition_5_reproducible: MET. The presence pattern is a deterministic function of the block seed and j and reproduces exactly.
audit_outcome.the_null: 850-855 holds nothing anywhere at any richness, which is a different situation from an absent scene inside a partition that does hold the motif elsewhere. Both now exist.
audit_outcome.the_populations_this_creates: The pairs a criterion must recover are C(j,2): 3 at j = 3, 6 at j = 4, 10 at j = 5, against 15 in the total-recurrence partitions. An error rate divided by 15 on this evidence would be the quietest possible wrong number, so the population is carried with the partition.
audit_outcome.the_patterns_are_not_contiguous: Planting subsets came out as [0,2,5], [1,3,4], [0,4,5], [2,4,5] at j = 3 and similar at j = 4, so a criterion cannot score by discovering a contiguous planting rule instead of the motif. Two blocks share the pattern [0,1,2,3,4] at j = 5, which is what independent draws sometimes do and is disclosed rather than adjusted.
audit_outcome.what_the_audit_did_NOT_do: It measured no criterion. Candidates C, D, 1, 2 and 3 were not run on these partitions and nothing here adjudicates any of them. The derivable facts stated in the design still stand and are still not findings: candidate 2's false split is 1.0000 here before it runs, and candidate 3 recovers the motif only at j = 5.
audit_outcome.these_partitions_are_now_development_evi: Built and inspected on 2026-09-10. No later renaming makes them fresh, and a criterion measured on them produces development evidence. Confirmatory evidence for a partial-recurrence criterion needs 880-895, which have still never been built and are refused unconditionally in code.
audit_outcome.what_is_now_possible_that_was_not: A criterion can, for the first time in this sequence, be wrong in both directions at once on the same evidence: it can reject a configuration that is genuinely present in only some scenes, and it can claim recurrence in a scene where the motif is absent. Every previous candidate was measured where recurrence is total, so only one of those errors was ever available to it.
